_comment: merchant name -> category. Categories MUST be one of mpc_integration/model_constants.py:ENCODER_CLASSES['merchant_category'] (Bill, Entertainment, Food, Grocery, Medical, Shopping, Transfer, Travel) or they'll silently encode as -1 (unseen category) under MPC. Person-to-person / unrecognized transfers intentionally fall through to the '_default' below rather than being guessed into a category.
